# PRD: Rules Encyclopedia Admin Closure

This fixture captures the real-project QA closure failure that drove Beacon v1.4.9 P0.

## Requirements

- AC-001: Implementation evidence must be bound before QA.
- AC-002: Markdown QA matrix must compile without placeholder fallback.
- AC-003: Go backend and UniApp frontend runners must be represented.
- AC-004: Environment blockers must not be reported as product failures.
- AC-005: This fixture must prevent false closure regression.
